compiled_state.title: CI Script Tests: test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh timeouts (>120s) causing Script Tests failure on main
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

**Component:** CI / test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh
**Condition:** test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh exceeds 120s timeout in CI
**Observed Result:** Script Tests job fails with TIMEOUT, causing CI to fail on main

**code_version:** 78a05b7e56

## Evidence

test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh consistently times out in CI at the 120s ceiling:
- Run 25891399809 (main @ 78a05b7e): Script Tests FAIL — test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh TIMEOUT
- Run 25896380993 (PR #124): Script Tests FAIL — test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh TIMEOUT

This failure predates PR #124 and is not caused by the verifier changes in that PR.

## Expected Behavior

test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh completes within the 120s timeout threshold.

comments.body: Classification: mechanical — test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh calls check-tag-guards.sh and check-reinvocation.sh, which invoke .claude/scripts/dso ticket show. That triggers _ensure_initialized in plugins/dso/scripts/ticket, which does git fetch origin tickets when the sync marker is absent. In CI the marker is never pre-warmed, so every ticket show fires a network fetch (~30-60s each). Fix: export _TICKET_TEST_NO_SYNC=1 at the top of the test file to use the documented skip path.
comments.author: Test
